command: set -euo pipefail; R=/home/andreas/self-integration; echo IDENTITY_HOST=$(hostname); echo IDENTITY_USER=$(id -un); echo HEAD=$(git -C "$R" rev-parse HEAD); echo BRANCH=$(git -C "$R" branch --show-current); echo DIRTY_BEGIN; git -C "$R" status --porcelain=v1; echo DIRTY_END; echo REMOTES_BEGIN; git -C "$R" remote -v; echo REMOTES_END; echo BRANCH_VV_BEGIN; git -C "$R" branch -vv; echo BRANCH_VV_END; echo ORIGIN_MAIN_LOCAL=$(git -C "$R" rev-parse --verify refs/remotes/origin/main 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING); git -C "$R" merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD refs/remotes/origin/main 2>/dev/null && echo LOCAL_CAN_FAST_FORWARD_TO_CACHED_ORIGIN_MAIN=1 || echo LOCAL_CAN_FAST_FORWARD_TO_CACHED_ORIGIN_MAIN=0; echo DONE=1
